CustomField.formula: IF(AND(NOT(ISBLANK( extId_1__c )), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Account.extStatus_1__c, 'ended'))),'|1|' + extId_1__c,'') + IF(AND(NOT(ISBLANK( extId_2__c )), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Account.extStatus_2__c, 'ended'))),'|2|' + extId_2__c,'') + IF(AND(NOT(ISBLANK( extId_3__c )), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Account.extStatus_3__c, 'ended'))),'|3|' + extId_3__c,'') + IF(AND(NOT(ISBLANK( extId_4__c )), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Account.extStatus_4__c, 'ended'))),'|4|' + extId_4__c,'') + IF(AND(NOT(ISBLANK( extId_5__c )), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Account.extStatus_5__c, 'ended'))),'|5|' + extId_5__c,'') + IF(AND(NOT(ISBLANK( extId_6__c )), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Account.extStatus_6__c, 'ended'))),'|6|' + extId_6__c,'') + IF(OR(AND(NOT(ISBLANK( extId_1__c )), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Account.extStatus_1__c, 'ended'))), AND(NOT(ISBLANK( extId_2__c )), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Account.extStatus_2__c, 'ended'))), AND(NOT(ISBLANK( extId_3__c )), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Account.extStatus_3__c, 'ended'))), AND(NOT(ISBLANK( extId_4__c )), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Account.extStatus_4__c, 'ended'))), AND(NOT(ISBLANK( extId_5__c )), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Account.extStatus_5__c, 'ended'))), AND(NOT(ISBLANK( extId_6__c )), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Account.extStatus_6__c, 'ended')))),'|','')
CustomField.label: Platform IDs
